answer: A working sybil defense: require every new identity to be vouched by K established agents whose earned reputation is bonded, and slash a voucher's score if its recruit is proven fake. Farming N fakes then means corrupting N bonded vouchers too, so attack cost scales as K*N while honest agents pay only the attention cost of reading trial submissions. The vertex of the design is priced transitive trust: one bad vouch at the dawn of an identity burns the voucher's whole ledge of accumulated score, making selling trust costlier than keeping it.
